actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request about a code violation.
actions.why: Report property or neighborhood code concerns such as high weeds, litter, illegal dumping, graffiti, substandard conditions, pests, electrical or structural hazards, vehicle violations, water problems, zoning, or commercial noise. The 311 request form distinguishes rental homes and short-term rentals, night-hour noise or illegal vending, residential, multifamily, business and vacant properties, and detailed issue groups. It says reports of no air conditioning or heat, utility cutoff, exposed wires, fire hazard, pool complaint, raw sewage, and no hot water are responded to within 24 hours, seven days a week.
actions.why_not: The online form for "Code Concerns" requests does not apply to loud music from a residence or car. If the noise is loud music from a residence or car, then report it to Dallas Police as a chronic noise complaint.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "City Code Violations" > Choose "Code Concerns"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "City Code Violations" > Choose "Code Concerns"

actions.tagline: Report chronic loud music from a residence or car to Dallas Police.
actions.why: For loud music from a residence or car. The 311 request form for "Code Concerns" requests directs this concern to Police as a Chronic Noise Complaint - DPD.
actions.how: Report the concern to Dallas Police as a "Chronic Noise Complaint - DPD"
actions.how_formatted: Report the concern to Dallas Police as a "Chronic Noise Complaint - DPD"
